description: Change a calendar: its name, or whether it shows Saturdays and Sundays (weekends). Pass only what changes. `add_data_sources` adds sources of events and `remove_data_source_ids` removes sources by the ids list_calendars shows (798); every other source stays as it is. Ids come from list_calendars.

add_data_sources.description: Sources of events to ADD to the ones the calendar has, each with date_field_id.

date_field_id.description: The date field the events stand on (id or name)

date_title_field_id.description: The field shown as the event's title

info_window_field_id.description: The field shown as the event's details

repeat_field_id.description: A yes/no field: only records where it is yes repeat every year

report_id.description: Instead of entity_id: a report's id, to show only its records

remove_data_source_ids.description: Ids of the sources to remove, from list_calendars

name: update_calendar
